greeting.text: You see me. Good. Most walk past without a glance. Sit. We should talk.

responses.text: I killed the goblin chieftain. You said you'd tell me more.
I don't talk to strangers in hoods.

identity.text: Names are leashes. I prefer to slip free of mine. Call me what you like. It won't change what I know.

non_answer.text: No. It isn't. But answers are earned in this world, not given. Prove your worth and I'll prove my trust.

responses.text: I don't need to prove anything to you.

prove_worth.text: The goblin chieftain in Thornwood. Kill it. That will tell me if you're the one I've been waiting for.

waiting_for_you.text: Old signs. A shift in the wind. The corruption accelerates and a new piece appears on the board. You.

not_pawn.text: Then be a player. But the game is already in motion, with or without your consent. Better to act than react.

testing_confirmed.text: Of course I am. Only a fool trusts blindly. Survive the chieftain and we'll have a real conversation.

purpose.text: To stop something old and hungry from devouring this land. Hearthholm is the first course. Not the last.

not_dramatic.text: In three months, Hearthholm will be a graveyard or a fortress. The only drama is in which one you choose.

why_you.text: Because the Guild will follow Rowan, Rowan will follow results, and you are someone who gets results. Or will be.

responses.text: What do you need me to do?

watching.text: I watch everything. It's what keeps me alive. Be glad someone is paying attention. Most here aren't.

knows_you.text: I know everyone who walks through Hearthholm's gates. Most don't matter. You do. Don't ask me how I know.

responses.text: What do you want from me?

trust_response.text: Good. You shouldn't. Trust is for people who share names and buy each other ale. We're not there yet.

responses.text: At least you're honest about it.

maybe_trust.text: Kill the chieftain. Then ask me again. Actions build trust. Words are just noise.

responses.text: What are you so afraid of?

what_they_know.text: I know the goblins are a symptom. I know the forest rots from within. And I know a name that would terrify you.

responses.text: You enjoy being cryptic, don't you?

name_refused.text: Not yet. Words have weight here, and that name draws attention from things best left undisturbed. Earn it.

cryptic_response.text: I enjoy being alive. Saying too much to the wrong person is a quick way to stop being either. Patience.

responses.text: Fine. What can you tell me?
I'll come back when you're ready to talk.

corruption_hint.text: Something old stirs beneath Thornwood. A pact made centuries ago. The seal weakens. That's all I'll say for now.

responses.text: How do you know about this?

pact_hint.text: With something that should have stayed forgotten. Kill the chieftain. Prove you can face what's coming. Then I'll say more.

persistence.text: Because it matters. The chieftain is the lock on a door. Remove it and we see what's behind. I need to know you can.

if_you_die.text: Then I wait for the next one. Harsh, but honest. Don't die. The world can't afford it right now.

knowledge_source.text: I've walked roads you haven't heard of, read texts that were supposed to be ash. Leave it at that. For now.

responses.text: You're connected to whatever is happening.

connected.text: More than I'd like. We all carry chains. Some of us are trying to break them before they drag everyone under.

post_chieftain.text: You did it. Skarnak is dead. Good. Now the real work begins. Sit. I'll tell you about the Hollow Covenant.

responses.text: The Hollow Covenant. Tell me everything.
First, tell me who you really are.

hollow_reveal.text: Centuries ago, desperate rulers bargained with an entity beneath the earth. Power for servitude. The Covenant was sealed.

responses.text: And now the seal is breaking?
Why should I care about ancient history?

entity_detail.text: It calls itself the Sleeper. An Aether-born thing, old as the stone. It feeds on life, twists nature to its hunger.

responses.text: The corruption. It's the Sleeper waking up.

sleeper_waking.text: Not waking. Stretching. Testing its chains. When it truly wakes, Hearthholm will be the least of our concerns.

responses.text: How much time do we have?

time_left.text: Weeks. Maybe a season. The fog, the beasts, the restless dead. All signs. The final sign will be silence. Then it's too late.

responses.text: Then we move now. How do we fight this?

seal_breaking.text: Cracking. Three anchor stones hold the seal. One is already shattered. The goblins were drawn to its corruption.

responses.text: Where are the other two stones?

anchor_stones.text: One lies deep in Thornwood. The other, beneath the eastern barrows. Both must be reinforced, or all is lost.

responses.text: Tell me what I need to do.

why_care.text: Because it's not history. It's happening now. Every goblin raid, every risen corpse, every twisted beast. All connected.

how_to_stop.text: Find the anchor stones. Reinforce the seal. You'll need the elf's knowledge and the cleric's faith. And my guidance.

responses.text: You're finally offering to help directly?
Why can't you do this yourself?

direct_help.text: I've been helping. You just didn't see it. Now I'm offering to step out of the shadows. That should tell you how dire this is.

responses.text: I still don't fully trust you.

final_trust.text: Nor should you. But we share an enemy, and that makes us allies enough. Trust can come later. Survival comes first.

why_not_you.text: I tried. Alone. I failed. The seal requires more than one soul's will. I learned that the hard way. These scars are proof.

responses.text: You tried to fight the Sleeper alone?

stranger_past.text: Another town. Another time. I was too late and too proud. Everyone paid for my failure. I won't let it happen again.

true_identity.text: I was a scholar of the old seals. I spent my life studying the Covenant. Now I spend it trying to prevent its return.

responses.text: A scholar? Not what I expected.
Tell me about the Hollow Covenant.

scholar_surprise.text: Knowledge is the sharpest weapon. Blades can't kill what's coming. Understanding might. Now, will you listen?

end_alliance.text: Meet me at the forest's edge at dawn. Bring Elara's ward and Aldwin's blessing. The real fight starts now.

end_dismissive.text: Your choice. But when the darkness comes, remember I offered to help. I'll be here. Watching, as always.

end.text: We'll speak again. Sooner than you think. Watch the shadows, friend. Not everything in them is me.
